pipeline.modality: Humanized IgG1 monoclonal antibody selective for toxic misfolded amyloid-beta oligomers (AbetaO)
pipeline.target: Amyloid-beta toxic oligomers (oligomer-selective; no plaque or monomer binding)

indications.indication: Early Alzheimer's Disease (mild cognitive impairment due to AD or early AD)
indications.trial_design: Randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled multiple ascending dose (MAD) Phase 1b; monthly IV infusion at 5, 10, or 20 mg/kg or placebo over 12 months; 144 subjects across 21 US sites

excluded_preclinical: PMN267 (TDP-43-selective humanized mAb / intrabody for ALS, FTLD, LATE) — IND-enabling studies
PMN442 (alpha-synuclein-selective humanized mAb for Parkinson's disease, dementia with Lewy bodies, multiple system atrophy) — IND-enabling studies; PMN411 back-up
AbetaO / alpha-synuclein / TDP-43 vaccine programs — preclinical
excluded_legacy_terminated: PMN310 Phase 1a SAD healthy volunteer study (NCT06105528) — COMPLETED 2024 (supportive of Phase 1b)
